title: Stored-Value Security on Instant Exchange Holds
content:
A customer holding spendable stored value with Marlowe & Finch carries a smaller card hold on a Returns & Exchanges Instant Exchange. The security share follows the spendable balance on the customer's Gift Cards & Store Credit instrument in status active, compared with the replacement value.

| Spendable balance on the active stored-value instrument | Share of the replacement value held |
|---|---|
| At least the replacement value | 0.5 (half) |
| At least half the replacement value, but less than the whole | 0.75 |
| Less than half the replacement value | The full value |

The share applies to the replacement value only; the sales tax on the hold remains worked out on the full replacement value.

## Both sides of each threshold (replacement value 120.00, hypothetical)

| Balance | Share |
|---|---|
| 120.00 | 0.5 |
| 119.99 | 0.75 |
| 60.00 | 0.75 |
| 59.99 | The full value |
